title: Example on how to use Pagination (Connector / Widget) in React Native
body:
Hello,

I could use the connectCurrentRefinements correctly because I found a working example but I can't figure how to use the connectPagination in React Native.

I can import it like the CurrentRefinements
`import { connectCurrentRefinements, connectPagination } from "react-instantsearch/connectors";`

I can use it like this :
`const ConnectedPagination = connectPagination(Pagination);`

But then I don't know what to do. How are we suppose to create a component to use the props available ? (https://community.algolia.com/react-instantsearch/widgets/Pagination.html)

I'm confused and new to this. Any help, advice ?

Thank you
